notes: Transmitter centre wavelength is λc−6.5 nm to λc+6.5 nm per channel (λc from ordering wavelength code table). Receiver centre wavelength range 1270–1610 nm. Operating case temperature grades: Standard 0 to +70°C (LS-CWxx1G-80C), Extended −20 to +85°C, Industrial −40 to +85°C (LS-CWxx1G-80I). Receiver sensitivity and overload measured with PRBS 2^7−1 @ 1250 Mbps, BER ≤ 1×10^−12. Average output power launched into SMF. Supply current Icc max 300 mA at 3.135–3.465 V (not stated in W).
provenance_datasheet_sections: 1.25Gbps SFP CWDM Transceiver, Single Mode, 80km Reach
